verses.text: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

segments.text: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me:
Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

verses.text: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

segments.text: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee;
The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.text: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.

segments.text: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth;
Keep the door of my lips.

verses.text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.

segments.text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing,
To practise deeds of wickedness
With men that work iniquity:
And let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.text: Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness; And let him reprove me, it shall be as oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.

segments.text: Let the righteous smite me,
it shall be
a kindness;
And let him reprove me,
it shall be as
oil upon the head;
Let not my head refuse it:
For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.

verses.text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

segments.text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock;
And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.text: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

segments.text: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth,
Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

verses.text: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.

segments.text: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord:
In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

segments.text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me,
And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.

segments.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
Whilst that I withal escape.
